text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her debut race drew closer, Kiseki's 
motivation kept soaring. Even during 
training that day—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Shukuchi!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...SHSHSHSHSHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Chanting her ‘special move’ as she ran, 
she quickly switched her footing against 
the ground.”
choice_data_list:
Focus more on "stepping with rhythm" 
rather than "kicking off."

Focus more on "stepping with rhythm" 
rather than "kicking off," okay?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Yes! It's a way of moving by using your 
body's core!
choice_data_list: 『蹴る』より『足踏みを意識した走り』だな
『蹴る』より『足踏みを意識した走り』だね
choice_data_list_en: It's running focused on 'stepping down' rather than 'kicking off,' huh.
It's running focused on 'stepping down' rather than 'kicking off,' right.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Since the foot's ground contact time is 
shortened, your leg turnover will increase 
too. It's useful, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her ideas may look like techniques 
straight out of a manga, but they contain 
solid "seeds of thought."
choice_data_list:
(I want to channel that rationally into 
running.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While bringing out the fun and uniqueness 
she has, how can I polish it into the 
ultimate, logically sound, most thrilling 
running style?
choice_data_list: （そこを合理的に、走りへつなげたい）
choice_data_list_en: (I want to connect that rationally to her running)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is where I prove my worth as a 
Trainer.
choice_data_list:
By the way, which part of your sole are 
you landing on right now?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Wait, the landing is...
choice_data_list: ちなみに今、足裏のどこで着地してる？
choice_data_list_en: By the way, which part of your foot are you landing on right now?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Toes first! But for this running form, 
would pushing off with the whole sole be 
more stable!?
choice_data_list:
Shall we test which technique is more 
effective?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
~~gh, right! I think I'd also like to try 
out a version where I land on my heels!!
choice_data_list: どちらが技として有効か、試してみようか
choice_data_list_en: Shall we test which technique is more effective?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking that could transform into 
an energy-saving mid-race 
skill............ Ah, and also!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Besides that, I've also prepared things 
like 'Double Breath' and 'Courier Sprint'! 
I'd love for you to take a look at all of 
them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, Kiseki brought forth one new idea 
after another."
choice_data_list: (Her talent is the real deal.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to create exciting races." That's 
how she puts her creative ideas to work in 
her races.
choice_data_list: （彼女の才能は本物だ）
choice_data_list_en: (Her talent is the real deal.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought my job was figuring out how to 
handle that natural-born gift, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the debut race.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Phew... haaah... ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki has been restless for a while now. 
She's pacing around the room with 
movements that seem to emphasize her neck 
in particular...
choice_data_list: Uh... You okay, Kiseki?
Um... Are you okay, Kiseki?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I-I'm fine! I'm, like... suuuper fired up!
choice_data_list: ええと……大丈夫か、キセキ
ええと……大丈夫？キセキ
choice_data_list_en: Uhm... are you all right, Kiseki?
Uhm... are you okay, Kiseki?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Maybe I should review the race 
strategy once more! After all, today is—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah...
choice_data_list: ...Kiseki!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quickly picked up the tablet that had 
slipped from her hands... and handed it 
back to her.
choice_data_list: ……キセキ！？
choice_data_list_en: ...Kiseki?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Ah, oops. Trainer. I-I'm sorry...!"
choice_data_list:
Don't worry about it. More importantly, 
are you okay?

Don't worry about it. More importantly, 
are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, yes. I'm fine! I'm really okay, 
so...!
choice_data_list: いいんだよ、それよりも君は平気？
いいんだよ、それよりも貴方は平気？
choice_data_list_en: I'm fine, but more importantly, are you okay?
I'm fine, but more importantly, are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm okay...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She repeats 'I'm fine' over and over, as 
if to convince herself. Watching her like 
that..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unlike the seemingly invincible girl she 
had always appeared to be, she looked... 
like an ordinary Umamusume desperately 
struggling.
choice_data_list: (...This is a miracle, too.)
(...This is a miracle, too, isn't it?)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?
choice_data_list: （……これもキセキなんだ）
（……これもキセキなんだね）
choice_data_list_en: (...This is a miracle too.)
(...I guess this is a miracle too, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To keep Kiseki from getting any more 
nervous, I speak to her while carefully 
avoiding words like 'anxious.'
choice_data_list:
Neither of us can stop trembling with 
excitement, huh?

Neither of us can stop trembling with 
excitement, huh?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Shivering... in anticipation...?
choice_data_list: お互いに止まらないな、武者震いが
お互いに止まらないね、武者震いが
choice_data_list_en: Neither of us can stop trembling with excitement, can we?
Neither of us can stop trembling with excitement, can we?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
choice_data_list: ああ、君はいつだってやる気だから
うん、貴方はいつだってやる気だから
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, you're always rearing to go.
Yeah, you're always motivated, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yes!! Exactly! I'm just trembling 
with anticipation, that's all!
choice_data_list:
Then go pour all that passion into your 
race!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes!!
choice_data_list: じゃあその熱意をレースにぶつけておいで！
choice_data_list_en: Then go channel all that passion into the race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki is a truly talented Umamusume. The 
well of ideas she sparks is bottomless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the Twinkle Series is not 
forgiving enough for one to compete on 
talent alone.
choice_data_list:
(As her Trainer, I need to support her 
too.)

(As her Trainer, I need to support her, 
too.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm not just a reader who enjoys Kiseki's 
creations. I'm her supporter, creating 
these works together with her.
choice_data_list: （俺もトレーナーとして彼女を支えないと）
（私もトレーナーとして彼女を支えないと）
choice_data_list_en: (As her Trainer, I need to support her too.)
(As her Trainer, I have to support her.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's still so much—so very much— that I 
can do for her in the days ahead.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Shaking with excitement. I see... so 
that's what 'trembling for battle' means.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that really makes you feel like the 
protagonist. Super... protagonist-like!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! Keep your eyes on me, everyone! Today 
is my "Episode 1"!
